title: Surreal Moonlit Wanderer
description: A lone figure in a dark coat and hat stands on a rocky outcrop overlooking a desolate landscape with distant factories under a giant full moon. A large ornate ship's wheel floats in the sky surrounded by colorful paint splashes, bubbles, and pink clouds, all framed by a glowing border with artistic debris.
prompt: A lone silhouette of a person in a dark coat and hat standing on a rocky cliff overlooking a barren landscape with distant dark factories, under a giant luminous full moon breaking through dramatic pink and purple clouds. A large ornate wooden ship's wheel floats in the center of the sky surrounded by colorful paint splashes and translucent bubbles. The entire scene is contained within a glowing rectangular frame with painterly colorful borders featuring buttons and feathers, surreal dreamlike atmosphere, cinematic lighting.
